faqs.question: How long does it take to build my website?
faqs.answer: Our average delivery time is 5 to 7 days for Starter and Business packages. Premium packages take roughly 10 days from receipt of all initial assets.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden monthly fees or subscriptions?
faqs.answer: None whatsoever. All our package prices are one-time payments. You own your code and domain 100%. The only recurring cost is your standard domain and hosting provider (typically $3-$8/month), which we help you set up.

faqs.question: Will my website work properly on mobile phones and tablets?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every website is built mobile-first. We test extensively across iOS and Android smartphones, iPads, and standard desktop screens to guarantee a seamless layout.

faqs.question: Can I request edits or revisions during the build?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every package includes dedicated revision rounds where you review the interactive staging link and we make adjustments before launching publicly.

faqs.question: Do you help with SEO so customers can find me on Google?
faqs.answer: Yes, basic technical SEO (meta titles, descriptions, schema tags, sitemap, and fast performance scores) is included in every project we launch.

faqs.question: What if I need updates or changes after the site launches?
faqs.answer: Our Business and Premium packages include free post-launch support. Beyond that, we offer low-cost on-demand update packages or easy maintenance retainers.

blogPosts.title: 5 Reasons Your Small Business Website Needs to Be Mobile-First in 2026
blogPosts.summary: Over 70% of potential customers visit your site from their phone. Here is why desktop-first design is quietly killing your conversions.
blogPosts.content:
## Why Mobile Optimization Matters More Than Ever
When customers search for local services, they are holding a smartphone in their hand. If your site takes more than 3 seconds to load or requires pinch-zooming to read, 53% of those visitors leave immediately.

### Key Benefits of Mobile-First Development
1. **Faster Load Speeds**: Clean, stripped-down styles keep mobile data transfer low.
2. **Higher Google Rankings**: Google strictly uses mobile-first indexing to rank search results.
3. **Frictionless Action Triggers**: Tap-to-call and WhatsApp click-to-chat connect customers instantly.
blogPosts.author: Teja Web Studio

blogPosts.title: How a Modern Website Directly Increases Local Inquiries and Sales
blogPosts.summary: Your website is your 24/7 digital storefront. Discover the small design tweaks that turn passive window shoppers into paying clients.
blogPosts.content:
## Turning Visitors Into Customers
A high-converting website isn't just about flashy visuals — it's about clarity and credibility. When visitors land on your page, they need to know:
- Who you are and what problem you solve
- Why they can trust you (social proof and real reviews)
- Exactly what step to take next (clear, high-contrast calls to action)
